title: Comfort for God's People

questions.question: Comfort, comfort my people, says your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 40:1 (ESV): "Comfort, comfort my people, says your God."

questions.question: A voice cries: "In the wilderness prepare the way of the whom?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 40:3 (ESV): "prepare the way of the LORD;"

questions.question: The grass withers, the flower fades, but the word of our God will stand how long?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 40:8 (ESV): "but the word of our God will stand forever."

questions.question: He will tend his flock like a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 40:11 (ESV): "He will tend his flock like a shepherd;"

questions.question: But they who wait for the LORD shall renew their what?
Speak tenderly to Jerusalem, and cry to her that her warfare is what?
And the glory of the LORD shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together, for the mouth of the LORD has what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 40:5 (ESV): "for the mouth of the LORD has spoken."

questions.question: Behold, the nations are like a drop from a bucket, and are accounted as the dust on the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 40:15 (ESV): "accounted as the dust on the scales;"

questions.question: Have you not known? Have you not heard? The LORD is the everlasting God, the Creator of the ends of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 40:28 (ESV): "Creator of the ends of the earth."

questions.question: He gives power to the faint, and to him who has no might he increases what?
Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand and marked off the heavens with a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 40:12 (ESV): "marked off the heavens with a span"

questions.question: Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and young men shall fall how?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 40:30 (ESV): "and young men shall fall exhausted;"

questions.question: Make straight in the desert a highway for our what?
Every valley shall be lifted up, and every mountain and hill be made what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 40:4 (ESV): "every mountain and hill be made low;"

questions.question: To whom then will you liken God, or what likeness compare with him? An idol! A craftsman casts it, and a goldsmith overlays it with what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 40:19 (ESV): "and a goldsmith overlays it with gold"

key_verse_text: But they who wait for the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings like eagles; they shall run and not be weary; they shall walk and not faint.
